feed.title: AKTUAL MEDIA — mreža izdanja
feed.subtitle: Sve stranice šest neovisnih izdanja, na jednom feedu.

entry.title: BOR USA — borilački sport u Americi bez šuma
entry.summary: Boks i MMA u Sjedinjenim Državama ne vodi jedna organizacija, nego pedesetak državnih komisija. Tko to razumije, razumije i zašto se ista borba u dvije države sudi drukčije — i zašto je najvažnija osoba u dvorani često liječnik, a ne promot

entry.title: BOR USA — combat sports in America, without the noise
entry.summary: Boxing and MMA in the United States are not run by one organisation but by some fifty state commissions. Understand that and you understand why the same bout is judged differently in two states — and why the most important person in the are

entry.title: How to read a fight card, in order
entry.summary: A card is not a list of names. It is a series of contracts stating the division, the number of rounds, the ruleset and the weigh-in deadline. Read that and you can judge an event before the first round.

entry.title: How BOR USA is made
entry.summary: Three rules: no figure without a source, no claim about a person without a document, and no announcement that cannot be checked. The rest is editing.

entry.title: Who sanctions a fight: mapping US commissions
entry.summary: There is no single regulator of combat sports in the US. There are some fifty commissions, one association that publishes the Unified Rules, and federal bodies that only get involved in anti-doping and fraud. That is the whole architecture.

entry.title: Safety in combat sports: the physician, the weight, the suspension
entry.summary: The biggest risk in combat sports is not a single strike but rapid weight cutting, too short a gap between bouts, and the decision to continue when one should not. All three are regulated — and all three can be checked.

entry.title: Kako se čita karta borbe, redom
entry.summary: Karta nije popis imena. To je niz ugovora u kojima su zapisani kategorija, broj rundi, pravila i rok za vaganje. Kad to znaš čitati, možeš procijeniti priredbu prije prve runde.

entry.title: Kako nastaje BOR USA
entry.summary: Tri pravila: nema brojke bez izvora, nema tvrdnje o pojedincu bez dokumenta i nema najave koja se ne može provjeriti. Ostalo je uređivanje.

entry.title: Tko odobrava borbu: karta američkih komisija
entry.summary: U SAD-u nema jednog regulatora borilačkih sportova. Postoji pedesetak komisija, jedno udruženje koje objavljuje objedinjena pravila i savezna tijela koja ulaze u igru samo kod antidopinga i prijevara. To je cijela arhitektura.

entry.title: Sigurnost u borilačkom sportu: liječnik, težina, suspenzija
entry.summary: Najveći rizik u borilačkim sportovima nije jedan udarac, nego naglo skidanje težine, nedovoljna pauza između borbi i odluka da se nastavi kad se ne bi smjelo. Sve tri stvari su regulirane — i sve tri se mogu provjeriti.

entry.title: Izbori u Srbiji: 31 zapisa iz 6 medija
entry.summary: Ovaj desk prati što mediji u Srbiji, Hrvatskoj, Bosni i Hercegovini i Sjedinjenim Državama objavljuju o izborima — i to ne prepisuje, nego broji i povezuje. Svaki zapis ima medij, grad, datum i poveznicu na izvornik.

entry.title: Serbia’s election: 31 items from 6 outlets
entry.summary: This desk follows what media in Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and the United States publish about the election — and it does not copy, it counts and links. Every item has an outlet, a city, a date and a link to the original.

entry.title: Outlets the desk reads
entry.summary: The desk does not pick outlets by sympathy. The archive carries whatever the eight city editions ingest, and public feeds are read from a fixed list. Both lists are public and change when the source does.

entry.title: How the desk counts, and where the limits are
entry.summary: The method is short and checkable: archive, criterion, count. Everything else is interpretation we do not publish.

entry.title: All items: 31 published
entry.summary: The complete list, ordered by publication time. No filtering by political option and no omission of uncomfortable items.

entry.title: Incidents and tension: 6 items
entry.summary: This is not a list of incidents — it is a list of items that mention an incident. The difference matters, which is why it is in the first sentence.

entry.title: Who writes and how much: outlets, cities, days
entry.summary: The table shows one thing only: how many items meet the method’s criterion. It does not show bias, reach or truth.

entry.title: Mediji koje desk čita
entry.summary: Desk ne bira medije po naklonosti. U arhivu ulazi sve što osam gradskih izdanja preuzme, a javni feedovi se čitaju po fiksnom popisu. Oba popisa su javna i mijenjaju se kad se promijeni izvor.

entry.title: Kako desk broji i gdje su granice
entry.summary: Metoda je kratka i provjerljiva: arhiva, kriterij, brojanje. Sve ostalo je interpretacija koja se ne objavljuje.

entry.title: Svi zapisi: 31 objava
entry.summary: Cijeli popis, poredan po vremenu objave. Bez filtriranja po političkoj opciji i bez izostavljanja neugodnih zapisa.

entry.title: Incidenti i napetost: 6 zapisa
entry.summary: Ovaj popis nije popis incidenata — to je popis objava koje spominju incident. Razlika je važna i zato stoji u prvoj rečenici.

entry.title: Tko piše i koliko: mediji, gradovi, dani
entry.summary: Tablica pokazuje samo jedno: koliko je zapisa koji zadovoljavaju kriterij iz metodologije. Ne pokazuje naklonost, ne pokazuje doseg i ne pokazuje istinitost.

entry.title: KOŠARKA 360 — kako se čita sezona, liga i brojka
entry.summary: Košarka se prati kao rezultat, a razumije kao sustav: pravila, raspored, tempo i prostor. Ovaj desk ne prenosi glasine o transferima. Objašnjava zašto se nešto dogodilo — i pokazuje gdje se to može provjeriti.

entry.title: Koje brojke u košarci stvarno nešto mjere
entry.summary: Postotak šuta bez broja pokušaja ne znači ništa. Poeni bez posjeda također. Brojka ima smisla samo kad znaš nazivnik.

entry.title: KOŠARKA 360 — how to read a season, a league and a number
entry.summary: Basketball is followed as a result but understood as a system: rules, schedule, pace and space. This desk does not carry transfer rumours. It explains why something happened — and shows where it can be checked.

entry.title: Which basketball numbers actually measure something
entry.summary: A shooting percentage without attempts means nothing. Points without possessions, the same. A number only makes sense when you know its denominator.

entry.title: European basketball: different rules, different rhythm
entry.summary: European basketball is not “the NBA with fewer points”. It is played under FIBA rules, on a smaller court, with a shorter game and a different relationship to space.

entry.title: How KOŠARKA 360 is made
entry.summary: No transfer rumours, no “greatest ever”, and no number without a source and the period it covers.

entry.title: How to read an NBA season: schedule, fatigue, playoffs
entry.summary: A season is not one table. It is 82 games spread over seven months, with travel, breaks and different motives in every part of the calendar.

entry.title: Europska košarka: drukčija pravila, drukčiji ritam
entry.summary: Europska košarka nije „NBA s manje poena“. Igra se po FIBA pravilima, na manjem terenu, s kraćom utakmicom i drukčijim odnosom prema prostoru.

entry.title: Kako nastaje KOŠARKA 360
entry.summary: Bez glasina o transferima, bez „najbolji ikad“ i bez brojke koja nema izvor i razdoblje na koje se odnosi.

entry.title: Kako se čita NBA sezona: raspored, umor, doigravanje
entry.summary: Sezona nije jedna tablica. To je 82 utakmice raspoređene preko sedam mjeseci, s putovanjima, pauzama i različitim motivima u svakom dijelu kalendara.

entry.title: SCENA ZNANOSTI — kako znanost stvarno nastaje
entry.summary: Znanost nije niz otkrića nego niz provjera. Ovaj desk prati proces: tko je rad recenzirao, je li objavljen prije recenzije, što je poslije ispravljeno i zašto se nešto povuklo. To je manje uzbudljivo od naslova — i mnogo korisnije.

entry.title: SCENA ZNANOSTI — how science actually happens
entry.summary: Science is not a series of discoveries but a series of checks. This desk follows the process: who reviewed a paper, whether it was published before review, what was corrected afterwards, and why something was retracted. It is less exciting

entry.title: How SCENA ZNANOSTI is made
entry.summary: One rule: the genre is never hidden. A preprint is a preprint, a reviewed paper is a reviewed paper, and a press release is a press release.

entry.title: Preprints: speed that requires a thinking reader
entry.summary: A preprint is a public paper before review. It is not less valuable — only less verified. The difference is that the reader must carry part of the checking.

entry.title: What a reviewer actually checks — and what they don’t
entry.summary: A reviewer does not repeat the experiment. They read the method, check the logic and ask whether the conclusion is larger than the data. That helps, but it is not the same as independent verification.

entry.title: Reproduction: the most important experiment is someone else’s
entry.summary: A result nobody can repeat is not a result but an event. Reproduction is therefore the least attractive and most important part of science.

entry.title: Kako nastaje SCENA ZNANOSTI
entry.summary: Jedno pravilo: žanr se nikad ne skriva. Preprint je preprint, recenzirani rad je recenzirani rad, a priopćenje je priopćenje.

entry.title: Preprint: brzina koja traži čitatelja koji misli
entry.summary: Preprint je javni rad prije recenzije. Nije manje vrijedan — samo je manje provjeren. Razlika je u tome što uz njega čitatelj mora sam nositi dio provjere.

entry.title: Što recenzent stvarno provjerava — i što ne
entry.summary: Recenzent ne ponavlja pokus. Čita metodu, provjerava logiku i pita je li zaključak veći od podataka. To je korisno, ali nije isto kao neovisna provjera.

entry.title: Reprodukcija: najvažniji pokus je tuđi
entry.summary: Rezultat koji nitko ne može ponoviti nije rezultat nego događaj. Reprodukcija je zato najmanje atraktivan i najvažniji dio znanosti.

entry.title: STEP BUDUĆNOSTI — ples, pokret i tehnologija
entry.summary: Ples je najstarija tehnologija pokreta i najmlađi olimpijski sport. Ovaj desk prati oboje: kako se pokret mjeri, kako se ocjenjuje, gdje nastaju ozljede i što pozornica traži od tijela.

entry.title: STEP BUDUĆNOSTI — dance, movement and technology
entry.summary: Dance is the oldest movement technology and the youngest Olympic sport. This desk follows both: how movement is measured, how it is judged, where injuries happen and what the stage demands of a body.

entry.title: How STEP BUDUĆNOSTI is made
entry.summary: Measurement before opinion: every claim about movement needs a method, a sample and a source.

entry.title: Dance injuries: load, warm-up, return
entry.summary: Dancers are not less exposed than athletes — they just report less. Foot, ankle, hip and lower back are the usual sites, and the usual cause is a sudden jump in load.

entry.title: Dance as sport: panel, categories and score
entry.summary: In competitive dance the winner is not whoever the crowd loves more, but whoever the panel scores against published criteria. Those criteria are not secret — they are just rarely read.

entry.title: Motion capture: from markers to markerless cameras
entry.summary: The same technology that animates films also analyses dance: it records joint positions, speed and trajectory. The difference is that a dancer needs feedback, not just footage.

entry.title: Kako nastaje STEP BUDUĆNOSTI
entry.summary: Mjerenje prije mišljenja: svaka tvrdnja o pokretu mora imati metodu, uzorak i izvor.

entry.title: Ozljede u plesu: opterećenje, zagrijavanje, povratak
entry.summary: Plesači nisu manje izloženi od sportaša — samo se rjeđe prijavljuju. Stopalo, gležanj, kuk i donji dio leđa najčešća su mjesta, a najčešći uzrok je nagli skok opterećenja.

entry.title: Ples kao sport: panel, kategorije i ocjena
entry.summary: U sportskom plesu ne pobjeđuje onaj koga publika više voli, nego onaj koga panel ocijeni po objavljenim kriterijima. Ti kriteriji nisu tajna — samo ih rijetko čitamo.

entry.title: Snimanje pokreta: od markera do kamere bez markera
entry.summary: Ista tehnologija koja animira filmove služi i za analizu plesa: bilježi položaj zglobova, brzinu i putanju. Razlika je u tome što plesaču treba povratna informacija, a ne samo snimka.

entry.title: ZDRAVLJE 360 — prevencija, san i kako se čita studija
entry.summary: Zdravlje se prodaje u tabletama i obećanjima, a najveći dio ishoda određuju dosadne stvari: kretanje, san, prehrana, cijepljenje i redovita provjera. Ovaj desk piše o njima — bez čuda i bez dijagnoza.

entry.title: ZDRAVLJE 360 — prevention, sleep and how to read a study
entry.summary: Health is sold in pills and promises, while most outcomes are shaped by boring things: movement, sleep, food, vaccination and regular checks. This desk writes about those — without miracles and without diagnoses.

entry.title: How ZDRAVLJE 360 is made
entry.summary: Guideline before opinion, absolute risk before relative, and a physician before any advice.

entry.title: Prevention: what has been shown, and what is only sold
entry.summary: Prevention is not the same as testing. Some measures lower risk demonstrably, some only reveal it, and some are sold as prevention with no serious review behind them.

entry.title: Sleep: how much, why, and what breaks it
entry.summary: Sleep is not passive time. It is the part of the day when memory consolidates, hormones align and blood pressure drops. Shortage is not compensated with coffee.

entry.title: How to read a medical study in five minutes
entry.summary: Most health headlines come from press releases, not from papers. Five questions are enough to tell the difference.

entry.title: Kako nastaje ZDRAVLJE 360
entry.summary: Smjernica prije mišljenja, apsolutni rizik prije relativnog i liječnik prije svakog savjeta.

entry.title: Prevencija: što se doista pokazalo, a što se samo prodaje
entry.summary: Prevencija nije isto što i kontrola. Neke mjere smanjuju rizik dokazano, neke samo otkrivaju rizik, a neke se prodaju kao prevencija bez ijednog ozbiljnog pregleda.

entry.title: San: koliko, zašto i što ga kvari
entry.summary: San nije pasivno vrijeme. To je dio dana u kojem se pamćenje konsolidira, hormoni usklađuju, a krvni tlak spušta. Nedostatak se ne nadoknađuje kavom.

entry.title: Kako pročitati medicinsku studiju u pet minuta
entry.summary: Većina zdravstvenih naslova dolazi iz priopćenja, ne iz rada. Pet pitanja dovoljno je da razlikuješ jedno od drugog.
